title: VampireReborn panorama
body:
A resource pack that adds a panorama to the main menu for the VampireReborn modpack.

You can play on our modpack here: [modrinth page](https://modrinth.com/modpack/vampirereborn)

We've separated it into a separate project because the background is quite large and increases the weight of the modpack itself.

Screenshots in 4K. CC0 - license.
Custom font in menu by [Liminal_Angel](https://modrinth.com/user/Liminal_Angel). [Download them](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/angels-font).
